instructions.primary_message: FOR THE FISH: Pre-heat oven to 325°F.
Pat fish dry of any excess moisture. Carefully cut into 4 evenly sized portions.
In a casserole dish large enough to fit the fish in one layer, spray with non-sticking cooking spray and add fish portions. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake for 12-14 minutes, or until white and flaky.
Remove from oven, discard excess liquid from dish, and leave at room temperature to cool.
FOR THE MASHED POTATOES: Peel 5 medium sized Yukon Gold potatoes. Cut into evenly sized chunks, about an inch thick, and transfer to a pot full of cold, salted water.
Boil potatoes for about 10-12 minutes, or until they are fork tender.
Drain the pot of water, leaving potatoes in the pot over low heat for 2-3 minutes so that they are able to dry out completely.
Using your preferred potato mashing device (I like using a food mill) mash the potatoes until soft and smooth.
Add 4 tbsp butter and mix until butter is melted. Add in milk a little bit at a time until your desired creaminess is achieved.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Allow to rest at room temperature.
FOR THE VEGGIE MIXTURE: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat for about 2-3 minutes.
Add onions and leeks and mix well. Cook over until veggies are completely softened (but not browned), about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add frozen peas and mix. Transfer to medium size mixing bowl.
Add in Crème Fraiche and grated Gruyere cheese and mix until well combined. Allow to rest at room temperature.

TO ASSEMBLE THE FISH PIE: Spread an even layer of the veggie mixture over the fish. Then, spoon the mashed potatoes on top and carefully spread out in an even layer. With a spoon, create evenly spaced circular indents in the mashed potatoes.
Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes at 350°F.

After 30 minutes (or until mashed potatoes are beginning to brown), remove dish from the oven. Drizzle each indent with an additional 2 tbsp melted butter and top with grated parmesan cheese, if desired.
Return to oven for 5 more minutes.
Remove and allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with some fresh chopped parsley and serve. Bon Appetit!
